minutes.headline: Economic Development Committee kept planning its business event despite the Business Association declining to take part.
minutes.summary: The committee reviewed a draft town-official meet-and-greet flyer, then spent most of the meeting on the Lunenburg Business Association's unexplained decision not to be involved in the planned event and whether to go ahead without it. Members also heard new-business and master plan updates. The only motion captured was to close the meeting.

attendees.name_as_heard: town staff member who drafted the flyer and the event description
member who relayed the Business Association's response

public_comment.topic: The chair asked for public comment; none was offered.

budget_items.what_was_said: A member said funding food is the challenge and offered to pay personally. Others suggested low-cost options such as trays, store-bought platters or sponsorship.
A member reported the association's dumpster-day and charity golf fundraisers to support its events.

decisions.decision: A staff member will contact the Business Association's president and share the outcome with members by email, as informational only, ideally before the association's next meeting.
The event date, time and concept will be raised at next Tuesday's department head meeting.
One member will meet with the town's social media coordinator about the flyer, and the committee will drive the content. No objection was voiced.
The committee leaned toward proceeding with the event and inviting the Business Association, unless it raises significant concerns.
